analysis:
Examined the head-side units of MultiModelBatchSchedulerEngine.swift (lines 998-2059), the new ReasoningStopScope.swift, and the bridge test metadata. The PR adds a reasoning-aware stop-string scope. ReasoningStopScope.scope(reasoningParser:reasoningPrefix:) returns a CBv2StopStringScope that excludes think and tool-call spans (Qwen3 and DeepSeek-R1) or Gemma channel and tool-call spans, and starts inside reasoning when the prompt leaves a think block open. The text path at lines 1043-1044 passes it to bridge.submitTokenized. The media path adds the same argument, plus a reasoningPrefix computed before the call (visible only in the patch excerpt).

Security relevance: this changes only where client stop strings match in generated output, which is a functional behavior change. It touches no key material, encryption, attestation, authorization, or coordinator-provider wire contract. The only data involved is the request's own stop strings and generated text, so TB-002 and A-001 confidentiality are unaffected. The scope is not derived from untrusted cache-scope values and does not touch prefix-cache salt handling (T-041). The cacheScope/cacheEnabled plumbing at lines 1039-1040 is unchanged.

The stop-scope parameter is inert when nil. The default case returns nil, which preserves whole-output matching. A client who controls stop strings can only truncate its own response, and the scope narrows where those matches apply, so there is no new escalation.

The cluster GLM and Qwen media paths (lines 1119-1336) and the MiMo path (lines 1340-1444) are unchanged in this diff. Their cacheEnabled:false/true settings are pre-existing, and I raise no regression.

Remaining uncertainty: the CBv2StopStringScope implementation and EngineV2Bridge.matchedStopSequence are outside the supplied text, as is the patch segment that removes lines near 825-836. I could not verify that the removed code carried no security-relevant checks. Those are unseen implementation contracts, so I did not raise findings. Release-path ordering (releaseBox/cancel) near the media submit looks consistent.
